name: Pulse — Desktop → Mobile
description: The scale read out of the two Pulse Figma frames (390px and 1440px). These numbers were not invented: each pair is the real value from each frame, which is why design and build cannot drift apart at the two widths anyone reviews.

notes.gridPt: Set to 2, not 4. Pulse's real frame values include 14px card padding and 10px small print, which are off a 4pt grid. Recording the deviation here rather than silently rounding it — worth a team decision, see the open questions.
notes.breakpointDiscipline: Every entry in structural.breakpoints must answer a question in plain words. Two breakpoints that answer different questions must not share a width just because they currently coincide — tying 'room for a sidebar' to 'room for a sentence' left the name column absorbing 400px of dead space at 899px.

type.advisoryNote: 10px small print is legible on a desk and marginal on a phone at arm's length.

--size-pinned-col.use: pinned item-name column — ABSOLUTE, never a percentage

static.buttonLabelNote: Static at every width. Shrinking the words on a button is how a control becomes unusable.

breakpoints.question: Is there room for a sentence of description?
Is there room for a sidebar?
Should the page header, search and tabs collapse into one sticky bar?
Numbered pages, or '1 of 10' with a progress bar?
Is there room for a second column beside the main one?
Is there a rail the carousel must not overlap?

navPattern.note: The phone tab bar is NOT the same list as the sidebar. Phones get the five things people do daily. This is a content decision, not a layout one.

tableRules.truncateOn: block-level wrapper inside every cell, headers included

structural.domOrderNote: Write the HTML in phone order so screen readers and the tab key follow it. Let CSS move the rail into its own column on desktop without reordering anything.

measure.selectorNote: SELECTORS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. Replace them with the real ones from the Pulse DOM before trusting a green run — a passing measure with wrong selectors proves nothing.

fixedWidths.why: The 44px checkbox column measured 52.8px at 768px. CSS table layout shares leftover space across every column unless exactly one column volunteers to absorb it.

color.note: Fill from the Pulse token set to enable contrast.mjs. Remember: judge every size at 390px.
